::: {#rem-source-coding-source}
#### Where the theorem comes from

@shannon1948mathematical proved that entropy is the limit on how far
the output of a source can be compressed.
@cover2006elements [sections 5.3 to 5.5] prove each part of @thm-source-coding.
For part 2, they give each value $x$ with $p(x) > 0$ the length
$\ell(x) = \lceil -\log_2 p(x) \rceil$,
its [surprisal](entropy.qmd#def-surprisal) in [bits](entropy.qmd#def-bits-nats) rounded up;
the Kraft inequality [@cover2006elements, section 5.2]
guarantees that a code with these lengths exists.

:::
